ABOUT.TEXT: Senior Software Engineer with over 10 years of experience, specialized in TypeScript (Angular, Vue) and .NET, working in an agentic way with AI every day. At {{age}}, I am currently a Senior Full-Stack Engineer at SQLI in Geneva, on assignment for SGS on a certification management platform: AI assistant integration, audit planning, .NET microservices and contribution to the migration to Angular 19. Before that, I spent 6 years at SFEIR as Lead Full-stack on an industrial IoT platform for SIDEL, Lead Full-Stack Angular/Java for Stellantis, Lead Front-End Vue/Nuxt for PROXIMIS, and Engineering Manager of a team of 13 developers. My approach: AI proposes, the engineer validates — quality, tests and security first.

PROJECTS.PANDAKEEP: A 100% local Markdown notes desktop app for Windows (formerly Pensly): no account, no server. Markdown mirror, full-text search, wikilinks and backlinks, per-note encryption, auto-updates, and AI autocompletion, local (Ollama) or cloud (Gemini, OpenAI, Mistral). Stack: Tauri 2, Rust, Vue 3, TypeScript, SQLite, Vitest
PROJECTS.CINECIRCLE: A social movie and series app: create groups, swipe on movies, match with friends and get a movie night pick based on everyone's taste. Available in French and English. Stack: Flutter, Riverpod, Firebase, TMDB API
PROJECTS.COPILOT_SWITCHER: A VS Code extension to switch between GitHub accounts for GitHub Copilot, without leaving the editor. Stack: TypeScript, VS Code Extension API
